item.text: The buffer and cursor API are in place. I’ve added tests for independent readers, overflow ordering, grace expiry, blocking reads, and cleanup; I’m formatting the code and running the package tests now.

The new package passes its race test. I also fixed a case where a small overflow tail could keep a large backing array alive. The existing `services.Fanout` tests are still compiling; I’m checking the final diff and will report their result.
The existing `services.Fanout` tests passed. I’m making one small performance change so the common path with no overflow skips grace checks across all cursors, then I’ll rerun the focused tests.

Implemented the generic `fanoutbuffer` in [buffer.go](/app/lib/utils/fanoutbuffer/buffer.go). It provides ordered reads through independent cursors, a bounded ring with an overflow backlog, grace period expiry, and cleanup on read or close. Added coverage in [buffer_test.go](/app/lib/utils/fanoutbuffer/buffer_test.go).

Verification passed: the package tests with `-race` and the existing `services.Fanout` tests.
